page_title: Shottr – screenshot app for pixel professionals

sources.entry: Shottr - Screen capture application with features like Scrolling capture, OCR and markup.

summary.name: Shottr
summary.one_liner: Shottr is a small, fast native macOS screenshot app with scrolling capture, OCR, annotation, measurement and color-picking tools.
use_cases: Capture a long web page or chat conversation
Extract text from an area of the screen
Annotate screenshots with arrows, text and shapes
summary.what_it_does: Shottr captures areas, windows or full screens and includes a scrolling capture mode for long pages. Its editor offers annotation tools such as text, freehand drawing, highlighter, spotlight, arrows, rectangles, ovals, step counters and a magnifier. Blur and pixelate tools can hide parts of an image, including text-only redaction. OCR copies recognized text to the clipboard and also reads QR codes, while ruler and guide tools measure sizes and a color tool copies the pixel color under the cursor. Optional features include a backdrop tool for gradients, shadows and rounded corners, pinned floating images, and uploads to S3-compatible storage.
notable: Native app optimized for Apple Silicon, about 2.3MB dmg
Text-only blur/erase mode that hides text without altering other content
Pin screenshots as floating always-on-top windows
Before/after two-frame GIF creation via image overlay
caveats: Most features are free, but the app periodically asks users to buy it; upload feature requires activation
Telemetry is collected by default, with an option to turn it off in Preferences; license activation needs internet
